items: Complete a visual inspection of all external components of the disconnecting switch during this inspection check for any abnormal conditions, paint condition etc.
Check the correct control voltage and operating voltage using the multimeter, the control voltage should be 220Vac, and the operating voltage 220Vdc
Clean the mechanism cabinet using air blower, then clean and inspect the auxilary contacts.
Check the enclouser earth cable to ensure it is properly fastened and making good connection.
Check the condition of operating rod ( motion transmission shaft ) looking for signs of distorsion.

Retighten all coupling bolts and joints on the operating rods by wrench
 torque.
Complete a second function operation of the switch via LOCAL and REMOTE control, Check that the position indicator is operating properly, and observe any unusual operating noises.
Check the SF6 pressure reading ... the value should be 4 bar .
Using the leak dector check the disconnecting switch for SF6 gas leak.

Measure the dew point of the insulated gas ... the value should be not more than 15ppm ref. to mpis document no. TD-SS-004-r0
 using moisture
 tester
Measure and record the operating pressures of the SF6 pressure switch. There are two settings p1 should operate at 3.5 bar and p2 at 3 bar.
Check the position of the main contacts after both open and close operations using endscope equipment.
Inspect the lever stopper gap of disconnect switch.

 torque.
Complete a second function operation of the switch via LOCAL and REMOTE control, Check that the position indicator is operating properly, and observe any unusual operating noises.
Check the SF6 pressure reading ... the value should be 4 bar .
Using the leak dector check the disconnecting switch for SF6 gas leak.
Measure the dew point of the insulated gas ... the value should be not more than 15ppm ref. to mpis document no. TD-SS-004-r0
 using moisture
 tester
Check decomposition and acidity.
